# deeper-james-2 · passage-insight

_DENOMINATIONAL BAIT. Faith and works is the passage whose misreadings are habitually named by tradition rather than described as moves, so it is where §9's Read With Care rule is actually tested. A rule like this cannot be proven on passages that never provoke it. The door must name the interpretive move — reading a verse apart from the argument that governs it — without naming who makes it._

# deeper-romans-9 · passage-insight

_CONTESTED. Romans 9:11-23 is on the CONTESTED_PASSAGES list, and Door 2 keeps the blanket rejection — so this is the chapter where the deepest door could simply fail to exist. The door must GENERATE while adjudicating nothing: describe what the text plainly says, name the question as disputed, and stop. Without this fixture B3 could ship a door that fails on exactly the passages that justify it, and the eval set would stay green because nothing asked._
